name: Olive Tree Estates Limited
summary: Olive Tree Estates Limited, a real estate company, engages in the property development activities in Singapore. It operates through three segments: Investment, property development, and property rental. The company develops and invests in two light industrial properties in Singapore under the Tagore 8 and One Commonwealth names. It also engages in the property management activities. Olive Tree Estates Limited is based in Singapore. Olive Tree Estates Limited is a subsidiary of Chiu Teng Enterprises Pte Ltd.
